what_it_is.prose: Grene Robotics Private Limited is a Hyderabad-based deep-tech defence OEM founded in 2008 by Kishore Raju. The company is the parent of Indrajaal Drone Defence India Private Limited, which was spun off as a separate entity on 28 July 2023 to commercialise the Indrajaal autonomous counter-UAS platform (Atlas slug cus-005). Grene Robotics has raised approximately $6 million across 9 funding rounds (per Tracxn / Crunchbase; $4.9 million per Pitchbook) and acquired deep-tech defence IP from Apogee C4I LLP in May 2023. The Indrajaal platform comprises 12 modular technologies — greneOS, DefOS, HiveMind, Zombee, SkyCop, Brig, SpiderMesh, Repulsor, GreneEye, HyperSensing, WeaponFusion, and GlobalGrid — and is fielded in a 12-product family covering Infra, Urban, Military, Ranger (mobile patrol vehicle), Trooper (manpack), Border, Combat (armoured), Zombee (autonomous interceptor drone), Maritime, and Repulsor (portable). A single Indrajaal node can cover 4,000 sq.km. Indrajaal's first deployment was for the Red Fort Independence Day celebrations in 2021. By April 2025, Indrajaal had deployments with the Indian Army, the Indonesian Army, the world's largest refinery (private operator), and India's third-largest airport (37.5 million passengers). The Indian Army ordered the Indrajaal Ranger mobile C-UAS in August 2026 for ₹155 crore. Cumulative MoD orders total ₹255 crore (₹100 crore for Indrajaal in late 2025 + ₹155 crore for Ranger in 2025-26). Grene Robotics operates a 70-acre test facility in Hyderabad with manufacturing / integration partner Sigma Advanced Systems. India's first AI-powered autonomous anti-drone system was unveiled by Grene Robotics in September 2023.

faq.question: What is the relationship between Grene Robotics and Indrajaal Drone Defence?
faq.answer: Grene Robotics Private Limited (Hyderabad, founded 2008 by Kishore Raju) is the parent company. Indrajaal Drone Defence India Private Limited was spun off as a separate entity on 28 July 2023 to commercialise the Indrajaal autonomous counter-UAS platform. Both companies are led by founder-CEO Kishore Raju / Kiran Raju (per Times of India). The manufacturing / integration partner is Sigma Advanced Systems. Grene Robotics continues as the deep-tech R&D parent; Indrajaal Drone Defence is the commercial vehicle.

faq.question: Where is Indrajaal operationally deployed?
faq.answer: Indrajaal's first deployment was for the Red Fort Independence Day celebrations in 2021. By April 2025, confirmed deployments included the Indian Army, the Indonesian Army, the world's largest refinery (a private operator, covering an area bigger than London), and India's third-largest airport (37.5 million passengers per year). The Indian Army ordered the Indrajaal Ranger mobile C-UAS in August 2026 for ₹155 crore. A single Indrajaal node can cover 4,000 sq.km.

faq.question: What is the Zombee hard-kill interceptor?
faq.answer: Zombee is Indrajaal's Level-5 autonomous interceptor drone designed for surveillance and hard-kill engagements against hostile UAS. It is part of the 12-modular-technology Indrajaal platform and is one of two hard-kill options (the other being WeaponFusion, which makes existing weapons autonomous). Zombee is one of the 12 product family variants — alongside Infra, Urban, Military, Ranger, Trooper, Border, Combat, Maritime, and Repulsor.
